verdict.rationale: BILL publishes an official Postman collection for the v3 API that can be forked from the Postman API Network. That is a machine-readable description of the endpoints, though not a true OpenAPI spec. BILL also offers an interactive API reference, plus llms.txt and markdown docs, but no evidence shows a downloadable OpenAPI/Swagger file. Missing for 10: an explicitly downloadable OpenAPI (or equivalent schema) file, documented schema coverage including the S&E endpoints, and independent confirmation that the spec can be retrieved.
